newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux up, Morgan Stanley buys.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux up, Morgan Stanley buys.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux rose against the trend on Friday while U.S. broker Morgan Stanley issued an "outperform" recommendation on the stock. It had previously had a "neutral" stance.
At 1046 GMT, Generale was up 0.7 percent to 717 francs while the CAC-40 index was 0.96 percent lower at 2,554.37.

Morgan Stanley analyst Michael Sayers said that the current price of Generale gave an opportunity to buy the share and he maintained his price target of 800 francs. He said that a possible win by the Left in Sunday's parliamentary election would not have such a negative impact on Generale as some fear.
Brokers Ferri also moved to a "buy" on the share and kept its target at 800/820 francs.
